tagline: Phase Connect drops a five-year triple reveal, Nijisanji EN floods the zone with merch and a bilingual single, and hololive Taiwan is actually tomorrow.
inThisIssue: Lia's first single in the wild

lead.title: Kaneko Lumi turned her five-year anniversary into a triple drop: new outfit, new stage, and debut full album 'Gliese 667'
lead.body: On July 18th, Phase Connect's Kaneko Lumi marked five years in the scene with a single stream that debuted a new Nun costume, unveiled a rebuilt stage, and launched her first full album simultaneously. 'Gliese 667' — named for the red dwarf triple-star system and tagged with 'I've loved the stars too fondly to be fearful of the night' — is out now on Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube Music, distributed through DistroKid. A physical edition in hardcover wallet format is available for pre-order at the Phase Connect store through August 18. Five years in and still finding bigger swings.

stories.title: Lia drops 'I AM LIA' — Phase Connect's founding-gen member premieres her first-ever single
stories.blurb: Phase Connect's Lia (Rinkou Ashelia) released her debut single 'I AM LIA' and companion piece 'WORLD OF LIA' on July 17, with the music video world premiere at 4 PM PT. The title — characteristically blunt, characteristically Lia — announces the release the same way she announces most things: by making it a bit and then delivering something genuinely good underneath. Founding-gen talent, first single, five years in. The timing is not a coincidence.

stories.title: BY THE BEAT announce 'MERORI' in two languages — Nijisanji EN's male music unit keeps building toward 2027
stories.blurb: NIJISANJI EN unit BY THE BEAT (Zeal Ginjoka, Freodore, Seible, and Kaelix Debonair) announced their second digital single 'MERORI' on July 19: the English version drops July 31, the Japanese 'MERORI (For Me)' follows August 5. Production credits include MUTEKI DEAD SNAKE, whose catalogue covers Snow Man and M!LK. Short clips launched simultaneously on TikTok and Instagram Reels. The unit's stated target is a major label debut in 2027 — every release is another step on that runway.

stories.title: Luxiem WILDWEST merch drops: Vox, Luca, and Shu ride into the NIJISANJI EN store with eight item types
stories.blurb: NIJISANJI EN's Luxiem dropped WILDWEST-themed merchandise on July 19, eight items in total — Poncho, Glitter Acrylic Stand, Flocky Mascot, Keychain, Sticker Set, Badge and Pin Badge Set, File Folder with Mini Poster, and Random Snapshot Card. The three-member lineup on this drop is Vox Akuma, Luca Kaneshiro, and Shu Yamino. The frontier aesthetic suits them. Fans are shopping.

stories.title: hololive night Taiwan hits Taipei Dome tomorrow — Marine, Kiara, Baelz, Koyori, and Vivi, two nights, baseball format
stories.blurb: The annual hololive x Wei Chuan Dragons collaboration comes back to Taipei Dome for July 21-22, with Houshou Marine, Takanashi Kiara, Hakos Baelz, Hakui Koyori, and Kikirara Vivi providing exclusive recorded content for each game. This year's guest: Houshou Kumarine makes her Taipei debut in-person. Admission gifts are different each night — Postcard Set on Tuesday, Cable Winder on Wednesday. If you've been sleeping on baseball-as-VTuber-event, Taipei keeps proving it works.

stories.title: Nijisanji EN male VTuber auditions close August 1 — no character pre-releases, full speculation mode engaged
stories.blurb: NIJISANJI EN's open male VTuber audition round runs through August 1 with no character design previews — unlike the concurrent female auditions, which came with partial reveals. Multilingual candidates welcome, fluent English required. The community has already started generating character concepts for whoever gets cast, complete with pre-formed opinions about personalities they haven't met yet. Parasocial preparation is happening at a clinical pace.

stories.title: hololive Dreams launches Thursday — 1.3 million pre-registered, and here's what they're actually downloading
stories.blurb: Three days out: hololive Dreams (Cover Corp and QualiArts) hits iOS, Android, and Steam simultaneously on July 23. The game is a rhythm RPG built around a theme park structure, featuring 150-plus songs including originals like BIBBIDIBA and Shiny Smily Story alongside covers like The Brave and Megitsune, with 50-plus talent cards at launch. Pre-registration cleared 1.3 million. A special 9th anniversary event is already planned for around October. Thursday is going to be a distracted workday for a lot of people.

indieSubhead: NO AGENCY, NO PROBLEM — NEWS FROM THE SELF-MADE CORNER OF THE SCENE

indies.title: Essie crosses 50k YouTube and 10k Twitch in the same week — indie growth doing exactly what it says on the tin
indies.blurb: Indie VTuber Essie hit 10,000 Twitch subscribers July 8 and crossed 50,000 YouTube subscribers July 16. The dual-platform grind — building Twitch community and YouTube audience at the same time — is increasingly how independent creators build sustainable reach in 2026, and Essie is running the playbook cleanly. Milestones hit, momentum sustained.

indies.title: The 2026 indie A-list is taking shape: Dokibird, Filian, Shylily, Mint Fantome, and Akuma Nihmune define the tier
indies.blurb: Roundups of the indie landscape keep circling the same half-dozen names: Dokibird, Chibidoki, Shylily, Mint Fantome, Akuma Nihmune, Bao, Filian. What separates them in 2026 isn't subscriber count alone — it's that each has built a creative structure, a community culture, and a content identity that's genuinely distinct. The indie tier isn't a fallback bracket. It's a different shape of the scene, and this cohort is what that looks like at the top.

indies.title: OffKai Expo Gen 5 opens in four days — the indie scene's biggest convention weekend is almost here
indies.blurb: OffKai Expo Gen 5 kicks off July 24 at San Jose McEnery Convention Center for three days — concerts, panels, vendor hall, meet-and-greets. kson, Henya, and Avallum headline the indie tier; the full lineup spans agency names to full-independents. At-door passes still available. After five years this event has quietly become the clearest annual proof that VTuber fandom is a convention scene now, not just a streaming niche.

tea.text: Word on /vt/ is that Kirsche's 'it's kinda, uh... complicated, I guess' response about future Pippa collabs from June is still generating threads six weeks later, with at least three running theories about what it actually means. Whether it's scheduling, agency policy, or two chaotic energies navigating a complicated orbit, management has said nothing useful and the speculation has hit hundreds of posts without landing anywhere. The thread is immortal now. Nobody's closing it.

The rumor mill says the three-member Luxiem WILDWEST merch drop has forums running quiet math about where the group's active roster stands heading into the back half of 2026. Vox, Luca, and Shu on the poster, and the threads cataloging streaming frequency and collab patterns have been growing alongside the merch shopping links. Less drama than arithmetic, but /vt/ can't help doing the arithmetic once it starts.

Chatter around the open Nijisanji EN male auditions has already produced multiple threads of community-invented character concepts — including fully designed references, voice clip wishlists, and detailed personality breakdowns for people who haven't been cast yet. The self-aware pre-parasocial energy is something. Someone in one thread called it 'grief for people who don't exist' and the reply count is triple digits.

footerNote: Next signal drops Monday morning — 27 July. OffKai wraps Sunday, Dreams will have had four days to sink its hooks in, and somewhere a Koshien coach is rage-quitting Power Pros at 2am. We'll see you there.
